{{Quote|The process of creating a Holocron cannot be rushed. The adjustments to the matrix must be made with precision and care.|The gatekeeper of Belia Darzu's holocron|<ref name="DBROT" />}}
The '''Holocron of Belia Darzu''' was a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]] created by [[Belia Darzu]], a [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] who reigned during the last quarter of the [[New Sith Wars]]. A four-sided [[pyramid]]al device, the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] contained Lord Darzu's knowledge of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], particularly [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and the [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] known as ''[[mechu-deru]]''. Following Darzu's [[Assassination of Belia Darzu|assassination]], the holocron remained inside her [[Belia Darzu's fortress|stronghold]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], serving as the final vestige of her power.

[[Standard century/Legends|Centuries]] later during the [[Golden Age of the Old Republic]], the holocron was [[Mission to Tython|recovered]] by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] who sought the secrets to constructing such a device of his own.

==Properties==
{{Quote|The capstone is key to the process. Without it the cognitive network will degrade before you complete your adjustments, and you will fail every time.''"<br />''"How do I trap the cognitive network inside the capstone?"''<br />''"You must invoke the Rite of Commencement.|The gatekeeper of Belia Darzu's holocron teaching Darth Bane|<ref name="DBROT" />}}
Created by the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Shi'ido]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] known as [[Belia Darzu]], the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] was a four-sided device that was shaped in the form of a [[pyramid]]. The holocron contained a [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] matrix capable of storing large amounts of information, among which included Darzu's philosophical views on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]],<ref name="DBROT" /> as well as her knowledge of [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]] and the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Force power/Legends|technique]] known as ''[[mechu-deru]]''.<ref name="CSWE-DARZU" /> In addition, it held instructions regarding the construction of a holocron, detailing the entire process—including the elaborate [[Rite of Commencement]]—while showing cutaway images of such a device. Upon activation, the holocron projected an avatar of [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] Darzu to serve as its [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]], mimicking her physical appearance and her inborn ability to [[Changeling/Legends|shape-shift]].<ref name="DBROT" />

==History==
{{Quote|Many also believe that before her death she discovered the secret of creating Sith Holocrons.|Hetton, regarding the Dark Lord Belia Darzu|<ref name="DBROT" />}}
[[File:BeliaDarzuCropped.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Lord Darzu recorded her alchemical knowledge in the Sith holocron.]]

In [[1250 BBY]] during the last quarter of the [[New Sith Wars]], a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] called Belia Darzu led the [[New Sith|revived Sith empire]] in a period known as the [[Sictis Wars]].<ref name="ATLAS">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> At some point before the end of [[1230 BBY]],<ref name="Holo date" /> Lord Darzu constructed a [[Sith holocron/Legends|Sith holocron]]; within this device, Darzu would record her philosophical outlook on the Force and knowledge of the dark side arts, along with comprehensive instructions on the creation of a holocron.<ref name="DBROT" />

The holocron was kept in the underground inner sanctum of [[Belia Darzu's fortress|Darzu's fortress]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], remaining there following her [[Assassination of Belia Darzu|assassination]] in 1230 BBY.<ref name="DBROT" /><ref name="NEDG">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> By this point, the holocron had been imbued with the power of the dark side, becoming the last surviving vestige of its creator. The dark side energy radiating from the device spread throughout Lord Darzu's fortress, attracting the remnants of her [[technobeast]] [[Metanecrons|army]] and prompting them to congregate around it.<ref name="DBROT" />

In [[990 BBY]], the holocron of Belia Darzu was [[Mission to Tython|located]] by [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], a survivor of the New Sith Wars who sought the secrets to creating a holocron of his own. After infiltrating Darzu's fortress and fighting off a horde of leftover technobeasts, Bane retrieved the holocron and scoured its contents while interacting with device's gatekeeper. The holocron was later briefly given to [[Darovit]], a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who kept the device hidden during a [[Duel on Tython|heated lightsaber duel]] inside the fortress. By the end of the fight, the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] of Bane—[[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]—recovered the holocron of Lord Darzu before journeying to the planet [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]].<ref name="DBROT" />

==Behind the scenes==
In [[2007]], the holocron of Belia Darzu was first depicted in ''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'', the second novel of [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[Star Wars: Darth Bane Trilogy|''Darth Bane Trilogy'']].<ref name="DBROT" /> The holocron later received its own entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released in [[2008]].<ref name="CSWE-HOL">{{CSWECite|II|51|Holocron of Belia Darzu}}</ref>
